_about: More parks for the National Park Ranking's search (assets/parks.js), 2026-11-06: every other National Park Service site (NPS API /parks, the 63 national parks left out: they are in national-parks.json) and U.S. state parks (Wikidata: instance of state park Q1761072 or a subclass, in the U.S., with coordinates, not dissolved; state from 'located in', a few by the nearest park), plus state parks named in USGS PAD-US 4.1 (designation State Park, or 'State Park/Beach/Recreation Area' in the name; parcels merged, ones Wikidata already has left out; ids sp-<state>-<slug>). Rows: id (permanent: nps-<parkCode>, sp-<Wikidata Q-id>), name (full), state(s), kind (nps or state), lat, lng (null when unknown). Wikidata is CC0; NPS and PAD-US data are public domain.
